title: Unfold mature approval documentation into primitives

source_context.description: Review of a mature process document and its linked approval log.
source_context.boundary: From mature document review through extracted primitives; no redesign.

trigger.description: A mature artifact is selected for reuse analysis.
trigger.entry_criteria: The artifact and its source links are available.

steps.action: Read the mature process document and source links
Separate reusable primitives from unsupported claims
steps.exit_criteria: Accepted, unresolved, and rejected material are classified.

steps.action: Determine whether the primitive has sufficient evidence
steps.exit_criteria: The primitive is accepted for refold or routed to recovery.

decisions.question: Can this primitive be reused without the unresolved threshold?
decisions.rule: Do not promote unknown evidence to confirmed.

exceptions.condition: A claim cannot be traced to a source.
exceptions.response: Restore the prior capture and stop the refold.

controls.name: Require source IDs on every extracted primitive

evidence.claim: The mature document contains a repeatable approval sequence.
The threshold policy is linked but unavailable in this boundary.

evidence.notes: Rejected because no source was provided.

ambiguities.description: The threshold policy is unavailable to this capture.
ambiguities.next_action: Review the policy before using threshold-dependent primitives.

rejected_material.next_action: Do not reuse until policy evidence is supplied.

fold.notes: This record starts from a mature artifact.

unfold.notes: Accepted and rejected material remain linked to source evidence.

refold.notes: Blocked by the unresolved policy threshold.

confirmation_gate.scope: Approver confirms extracted primitives and rejected material handling.

recovery.next_action: Restore the prior capture if any primitive loses its source link.
